title: Felix and the Letters
author: Wendell Nakamura
blurb: Kestrel Dunmore, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
